description: This file defines an abstract base class NumberBase for handling number formatting settings, including locale management and decimal precision, intended for use in a PHP spreadsheet manipulation library.

classes.name: NumberBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing basic functionality for number formatting, such as setting decimals and locales, to be extended by concrete classes.

methods.name: setDecimals
methods.description: Sets the number of decimal places, capped at a maximum of 30.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale for number formatting and updates the locale format accordingly.

methods.name: getLocaleFormat
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented in subclasses to return appropriate locale format string.

methods.name: validateLocale
methods.description: Validates and formats a locale string, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the default number format string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the number format.
